fields.Name: W2 -> S5.3
fields.Description: Gate G0.9 (owner PR 2, phase 0, dataset W2, criterion S5.3): on W2-noise s100, kfold and holdout validation report an AUC whose 95% Hanley-McNeil interval contains 0.5, 2 of 2. The interval uses the sidecar's own metrics: auc, and n / n_positive, the label counts of the rows the validation AUC was computed on (the pooled out-of-fold rows for kfold, the held-out split for holdout). No refusal code applies to noise data, so a failed training is an error.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Both strategies' validation AUC intervals contain 0.5.
